title: T-HITL Effectively Addresses Problematic Associations in Image Generation and Maintains Overall Visual Quality
reasoning: The paper centers on identifying and mitigating 'problematic associations' in AI, specifically focusing on harms like dehumanization, marginalization, and villainization of demographic groups. It develops a taxonomy of these associations based on sociological theories of prejudice and evaluates the effectiveness of its T-HITL method in reducing these ethically problematic outputs.
